phrase: The hungry alligator eats the bigger number.
also: Open the mouth toward the larger number.
steps: Draw < or > as an open mouth.
Point the open side at the greater number.
suspected_exception: Fails if students confuse left/right facing without comparing values first.
source_notes: Online Math Learning — classic K comparison mnemonic

phrase: Put the big number in your head, then count on.
suspected_exception: Inefficient for large addends; may encourage counting by ones forever.

phrase: Make a ten, then add the rest.
steps: Split one addend to complete a ten.
suspected_exception: Needs solid number-bond fluency.

phrase: Doubles plus one: double the small number, then add one more.
suspected_exception: Students sometimes double the larger number instead.

phrase: Even numbers share fair: everyone gets a buddy. Odd numbers leave one out.
steps: Even: no leftover; odd: one leftover.
suspected_exception: Confuses with divisible-by-2 for large numbers if pairing is skipped.

phrase: Five or more, raise the score. Four or less, let it rest.
suspected_exception: Banker's rounding / half-even not taught; nines carry can confuse.

phrase: Hour is a short word: short hand. Minute is a long word: long hand.
suspected_exception: Digital clocks and 24-hour time break the metaphor.

phrase: More on top? No need to stop. More on the floor? Go next door and get ten more.
steps: If bottom larger, borrow ten from next place.
suspected_exception: Doesn't address zeros in the middle (cascading borrows).

phrase: Ten ones make a ten. Carry the one next door.
steps: If 10+, write ones digit and carry a ten.
suspected_exception: Students carry without writing the ones digit.

phrase: Knuckles are 31-day months; dents between are shorter.
also: Thirty days hath September, April, June, and November.
suspected_exception: Leap year February; must skip thumb and continue to other hand correctly.
source_notes: Ian Gibbs / Online Math Learning calendar mnemonics

phrase: Thirty days hath September, April, June, and November.
suspected_exception: Leap year exception for February.

phrase: Times means groups of.
steps: Read a×b as a groups of b.
suspected_exception: Order language can confuse commutative property.

phrase: Fold the finger for ×9. Left fingers are tens; right are ones.
also: Digits of a ×9 fact always add to 9.
suspected_exception: Only for 1–10 × 9; multi-digit needs place value.

phrase: Five, six, seven, eight: fifty-six is seven times eight.
suspected_exception: Only helps one fact.

phrase: Does McDonald's Sell Cheese Burgers?
also: Dad, Mother, Sister, Brother, Rover — Divide, Multiply, Subtract, Bring down, Repeat/Remainder.
suspected_exception: Omits 'compare' step; cheese/compare variants differ; doesn't build place-value sense.
source_notes: Online Math Learning / Memory Joggers long-division family mnemonic

phrase: 2-5-10 End, 3-9 Sum, 4-8 Back, 11 Alternate.
suspected_exception: Rule for 7 is omitted; 6 needs both 2 and 3.
source_notes: Compact divisibility mnemonic used in test-prep/teacher materials

phrase: Perimeter is the fence around. Area is the carpet inside.
suspected_exception: Students still swap formulas under time pressure.

phrase: What you do to the top, you do to the bottom.
suspected_exception: Does not apply to adding fractions; students may 'do the same' when adding.

phrase: Fives are half of tens — and they end in 0 or 5.
suspected_exception: Half-of-tens fails for odd multiples if students forget halves.

phrase: ×2 is double. ×4 is double-double. ×8 is double-double-double.
suspected_exception: Error compounds with each double.

phrase: For ×11: split the digits and park their sum in the middle.
steps: Write digit sum in middle (carry if ≥10).
suspected_exception: Two-digit ×11 needs carry handling.

phrase: Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally.
also: Please Educate My Daughters And Sons.
suspected_exception: Students do all M before D (or A before S); PEMDAS letter order misleads.
source_notes: Math Is Fun / Mathnasium / Online Math Learning

phrase: BODMAS: Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction.
also: BIDMAS uses Indices instead of Orders.
suspected_exception: Same left-to-right trap as PEMDAS; D before M myth.

phrase: BEDMAS: Brackets, Exponents, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction.
suspected_exception: Same M/D left-to-right misconception.

phrase: GEMS: Grouping, Exponents, Multiply/Divide, Subtract/Add.
also: GEMDAS
suspected_exception: Still needs left-to-right within levels.
source_notes: Math Is Fun alternative to PEMDAS

phrase: Keep, Change, Flip.
also: Kentucky Chicken Fried / Kangaroo Candy Flowers.
suspected_exception: Doesn't explain why; students flip the first fraction; mixed numbers need conversion first.
source_notes: Memory Joggers / Online Math Learning KCF

phrase: Same bottom, add the tops.
suspected_exception: Students add denominators too.

phrase: Straight across: tops times tops, bottoms times bottoms.
suspected_exception: Students seek common denominators unnecessarily.

phrase: Numerator up, denominator down.
also: Nice Dog (N before D); No Dirty Dogs.
suspected_exception: Doesn't help with improper vs mixed.
source_notes: Online Math Learning fraction part names

phrase: MAD face: Multiply, Add, Denominator stays.
suspected_exception: Students multiply by numerator instead.

phrase: Line up the dots.
suspected_exception: Students right-align like whole numbers.

phrase: Ignore the dots, multiply, then count the places back in.
suspected_exception: Trailing zeros and place-count errors.

phrase: Make the divisor whole: hop both dots the same number of places.
suspected_exception: Unequal hops; remainder place value.

phrase: King Henry Died By Drinking Chocolate Milk.
also: King Hector Doesn't Usually Drink Cold Milk.
steps: Kilo Hecto Deca Base Deci Centi Milli
Move decimal by steps between units.
suspected_exception: Skipping 'By/Base'; mega/micro not included.
source_notes: LivePhysics / Online Math Learning metric ladder

phrase: Hey diddle diddle, the median's the middle; you add and divide for the mean. The mode is the most, and the range is the difference between.
also: Mode = Most Occurring Data Entity.
suspected_exception: Even-count median needs average of two middles; multimodal data.
source_notes: Online Math Learning rhyme / Lesser statistics mnemonics

phrase: Mode and most share the first two letters.
also: MODE = Most Occurring Data Entity.
steps: Find the value that appears most.
suspected_exception: No mode or multiple modes.

phrase: The median splits the data down the middle, like a median strip in a road.
suspected_exception: Even n requires averaging two middles.

phrase: My friend's enemy is my enemy; my enemy's enemy is my friend.
also: Same signs positive; different signs negative.
suspected_exception: Students over-apply to addition of signed numbers.

phrase: Friends are positive. Strangers are negative.
suspected_exception: Metaphor stretched for addition/subtraction.

phrase: I View X-rays: I=1, V=5, X=10.
also: I Viewed Xerxes Loping Carelessly Down Mountains.
suspected_exception: Subtractive notation (IV, XL) still trips students.
source_notes: Online Math Learning Roman numeral phrases

phrase: 5 tomatoes: 5,280 feet in a mile.
also: Five tomatoes → five-two-eight-oh.
suspected_exception: Pure memorization; no unit sense.
source_notes: Online Math Learning quirky unit mnemonic

phrase: A Rat In The House May Eat The Ice Cream.
steps: Use first letters to spell ARITHMETIC.
suspected_exception: Trivia; not mathematical.

phrase: Commutative: the commute is the same either direction.
suspected_exception: Does not apply to subtraction/division.

phrase: Associative: associate means group up.
suspected_exception: Not for subtraction/division.

phrase: Distributive: give what's outside to everyone inside.
suspected_exception: Forgetting to distribute to every term.

phrase: The dividend is at the end; the quotient is the result.
also: Short 'or' (divisor) outside the house; longer 'end' (dividend) inside.
suspected_exception: House diagram orientation varies by curriculum.

phrase: Same signs: add and keep. Different signs: subtract and keep the bigger one's sign.
steps: Different → subtract; keep larger magnitude's sign.
suspected_exception: 'Bigger' means absolute value, not algebraically larger.

phrase: Keep, Change, Change.
also: Subtracting is adding the opposite.
suspected_exception: Confused with Keep-Change-Flip for fractions.

phrase: Per cent means out of 100. Hop the decimal two places.
suspected_exception: Percent of percent; relative vs absolute change.

phrase: I = PRT — I am pretty.
also: Interest = Principal × Rate × Time.
suspected_exception: Rate must match time unit; compound interest different.

phrase: d = rt — remember dirt.
suspected_exception: Average vs instantaneous rate; unit consistency.

phrase: Cover up what you want in the D-S-T triangle.
suspected_exception: Triangle doesn't teach units or average speed pitfalls.

phrase: Do the opposite to both sides.
suspected_exception: Forgetting to apply to every term; inequality flip omitted.

phrase: Cherry pie's delicious: C = πd. Apple pies are too: A = πr².
also: Around the circle is pi times d; area is π r squared.
suspected_exception: Using r with C=πd or d with A=πr²; diameter vs radius mix-ups.
source_notes: Online Math Learning / Lesser pi jingles

phrase: Apple pies are square: A = π r².
also: Apple pies are round: A = π × r × r.
suspected_exception: 'Square' confuses with geometric square shape.

phrase: What you want, over all you've got.
suspected_exception: Assumes equally likely; compound events need care.

phrase: Cross multiply: the butterfly method.
suspected_exception: Used incorrectly on non-proportions; sign errors.

phrase: New minus old, over old, times 100.
suspected_exception: Using new as denominator; successive percent changes.

phrase: Sale? Take it off. Tax? Put it on.
suspected_exception: Sale-then-tax vs tax-then-sale order; successive discounts.

phrase: Along the corridor, up the stairs.
also: Run then rise; x then y.
suspected_exception: Students swap x/y under pressure.

phrase: Cover the floor, then stack the floors: length × width × height.
suspected_exception: Using slant height; unit cubes vs formula disconnect.

phrase: A triangle is half the box: base × height ÷ 2.
suspected_exception: Using a non-perpendicular side as height.

phrase: Slope is rise over run.
suspected_exception: Run zero (undefined); sign of rise/run; counting graph squares wrong.

phrase: y = mx + b: Begin at b, then Move with m.
suspected_exception: Positive/negative slope direction; confusing b with x-intercept.

phrase: Multiply → add powers. Divide → subtract. Power of a power → multiply.
suspected_exception: Different bases; negative exponents forgotten.
source_notes: Online Math Learning exponent song themes

phrase: Negative exponent: take one over with a positive power.
suspected_exception: Applying to the wrong factor; (−2)^(−3) sign errors.

phrase: One digit, then a dot, times a power of ten.
suspected_exception: Wrong exponent sign when moving left vs right.

phrase: Square the legs, add them, and that is the long side squared.
also: a² + b² = c²
suspected_exception: Using a non-hypotenuse as c; converse misuse.

phrase: Three corners make a straight line: 180°.
steps: Interior angles of a triangle sum to 180°.
suspected_exception: Spherical geometry; exterior vs interior confusion.

phrase: Four corners make a full turn: 360°.
steps: Interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°.
suspected_exception: Concave quads / complex polygons.

phrase: F angles copy, Z angles copy, C angles make 180°.
also: Corresponding equal; alternate equal; co-interior supplementary.
suspected_exception: Mis-drawing F/Z/C on slanted diagrams.

phrase: Twin sides, twin angles.
also: Underline the two S's in iSoSceles.
suspected_exception: Assuming vertex angle also equal.
source_notes: Chloe Campbell Education / Online Math Learning

phrase: Complementary = Corner (90°). Supplementary = Straight (180°).
also: C before S; 90 before 180. One p vs two p's.
suspected_exception: Angles need not be adjacent; students require shared ray wrongly.

phrase: Acute is a 'cute' little angle (less than 90°).
also: Obtuse = open / obese-sounding larger angle.
suspected_exception: Obtuse vs reflex confusion.

phrase: Scalene is the odd one out: no equal sides.
also: Equilateral has 'equal' in the word.
suspected_exception: Mixing side and angle classification names.

phrase: Slide, flip, or turn: translation, reflection, rotation.
suspected_exception: Orientation/congruence after composition; glide reflections.

phrase: Cut the polygon into triangles: (n − 2) × 180°.
suspected_exception: Using exterior formula by mistake; regular vs irregular.

phrase: Walk around the shape: exterior angles always add to 360°.
suspected_exception: Wrong exterior (adjacent interior) choice; concave polygons.

phrase: A cone is one-third of the cylinder with the same base and height.
suspected_exception: Using slant height as h.

phrase: Cylinder volume is the circle floor times the height: πr²h.
suspected_exception: Surface area formula mix-up.

phrase: Sphere volume: (4/3)πr³.
suspected_exception: Confusing with surface area 4πr².

phrase: FOIL: First, Outside, Inside, Last.
also: First, Outer, Inner, Last.
suspected_exception: Only for two binomials; misses general distribution; sign errors on negatives.

phrase: x equals negative b, plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a.
suspected_exception: Sign of −b; forgetting ±; discriminant negative; dividing only part by 2a.
source_notes: Online Math Learning Pop Goes the Weasel song (paraphrased)

phrase: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).
also: Difference of squares.
suspected_exception: Trying a²+b² the same way.

phrase: Find two numbers that multiply to c and add to b.
suspected_exception: Fails when a≠1 without AC method; sign errors.

phrase: Solve like an equation — but flip the sign when you multiply or divide by a negative.
suspected_exception: Forgetting flip; flipping when subtracting negatives.

phrase: Parallel: same slope. Perpendicular: flip the fraction and change the sign.
also: Negative reciprocal.
suspected_exception: Horizontal/vertical special cases; forgetting the sign change.

phrase: b² − 4ac: positive two, zero one, negative none (real roots).
suspected_exception: Complex roots still exist when Δ<0; multiplicity language.

phrase: STAR: Search, Translate, Answer, Review.
suspected_exception: Overly generic; doesn't ensure correct model.

phrase: SOH CAH TOA.
also: Some Old Horses Can Always Hear Their Owner's Approach.
suspected_exception: Wrong opposite/adjacent relative to reference angle.
source_notes: Online Math Learning / MathWorld / teacher lesson

phrase: Oscar Had A Heap Of Apples.
also: Tommy On A Ship Of His Caught A Herring.
suspected_exception: Phrase order must match sin/cos/tan.

phrase: All Students Take Calculus.
also: Add Sugar To Coffee; A Smart Trig Class.
suspected_exception: CAST starts in Q4 and reverses letter order; reciprocal functions follow co-function's sign.

phrase: CAST rule (starting from Quadrant IV going counterclockwise): Cos, All, Sin, Tan positive.
suspected_exception: Students mix CAST with ASTC starting corner.
source_notes: Online Math Learning / Brock University notes

phrase: Cosec flips sine, sec flips cosine, cot flips tangent.
also: The 'co' partners aren't always intuitive—sec pairs with cos.
suspected_exception: Thinking sec=1/sin.

phrase: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; divide by cos² or sin² for the tan/cot forms.
suspected_exception: Forgetting which form; mixing squared placement.

phrase: 'Co' means complement: sin(90°−θ)=cos θ.
steps: Complementary angles swap sin↔cos, tan↔cot, sec↔csc.
suspected_exception: Using 180° instead of 90°; radian form π/2.

phrase: Elevation looks up, depression looks down, both from the horizontal.
suspected_exception: Measuring from vertical; diagram orientation.

phrase: Sine is y, cosine is x on the unit circle.
suspected_exception: Swapping x/y; degrees vs radians.

phrase: May I have a large container of coffee? (3.1415926)
also: May I have a large container of coffee ready for today?
steps: Count letters in each word for digits.
suspected_exception: Letter-count typos; not a calculation aid.
source_notes: Online Math Learning pi word-length mnemonic

phrase: Same size and shape: SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS.
also: HL for right triangles.
suspected_exception: SSA is not generally valid (ambiguous case).

phrase: Bring the power down in front, then take one off the power.
suspected_exception: Constants, fractional/negative powers, chain rule needed for composites.

phrase: First d-second plus second d-first.
also: First times derivative of second, plus second times derivative of first.
suspected_exception: Multiplying the two derivatives only.

phrase: Low d-high minus high d-low, over the low squared.
also: Low D-high minus High D-low, square the bottom and away we go.
suspected_exception: Reversing subtraction order; forgetting square denominator.

phrase: Derivative of the outside, keep the inside, times derivative of the inside.
suspected_exception: Forgetting to multiply by inner derivative.

phrase: sin → cos → −sin → −cos → sin.
also: Derivative of sine is cosine; derivative of cosine is negative sine.
suspected_exception: Missing negatives; degrees mode on calculators.

phrase: Raise the power by one, divide by the new power, and add C.
suspected_exception: Forgetting +C; n=−1 needs ln.

phrase: LIATE: Logarithmic, Inverse trig, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential — choose u earlier in the list.
also: ILATE; DETAIL for choosing dv.
suspected_exception: Fails on some integrands (opportunistic choice better); cyclic integrals.
source_notes: Leaves of Math / MemoryTricks / Harvard Math 1A

phrase: See f(g(x))·g'(x)? Let u = g(x).
suspected_exception: Missing constant factors; definite-integral bound conversion.

phrase: Log asks: what power?
steps: log_b a = c means b^c = a
suspected_exception: Change-of-base errors; log of negative.

phrase: Logs turn × into +, ÷ into −, and powers out front.
suspected_exception: log(x+y) wrongly split; base issues.

phrase: Differentiation and integration are inverse operations.
also: ∫_a^b f = F(b)−F(a).
steps: Or derivative of integral recovers f.
suspected_exception: Wrong limits; absolute value for √ etc.

phrase: Permutations when order matters; combinations when order does not.
also: A perm costs money so order matters; a comb is free so order doesn't.
suspected_exception: With/without replacement; indistinguishable objects.

phrase: For typical unimodal skew: mean-median-mode alphabetical for left skew; reverse-alphabetical for right skew.
steps: Right skew: mode, median, mean order.
suspected_exception: Not always true (von Hippel exceptions).

phrase: P-value: chance, with the null true, of data at least this extreme.
steps: Find tail probability of observed (or more extreme) result
suspected_exception: Treating p as P(H0 true); p-hacking.

phrase: Whiskers reach the furthest point within a 1.5 IQR leash from the quartiles.
suspected_exception: Software defaults differ; some curricula use different multipliers.

phrase: Old MacDonald used chi-square: E, I, E, I, O.
steps: E,I,E,I,O maps expected, minus, expected, divide, observed structure
suspected_exception: Only a memory scaffold; still need correct expected counts.

phrase: Each side over the sine of the angle it faces.
also: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C.
suspected_exception: Ambiguous case (SSA).

phrase: Pythagoras with a correction: a² = b² + c² − 2bc cos A.
suspected_exception: Sign of cosine in obtuse triangles; wrong opposite side.

phrase: Half of two sides times the sine of the included angle.
suspected_exception: Using non-included angle.

phrase: sin cos cos sin, sign stays. cos cos sin sin, sign swaps.
suspected_exception: Wrong sign patterns; tan formula separate.

phrase: Double the angle: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A.
suspected_exception: Mixing cos double-angle forms.

phrase: π is 180°. To radians × π/180; to degrees × 180/π.
suspected_exception: Multiplying by π or 180 alone.

phrase: Lengths × k, areas × k², volumes × k³.
suspected_exception: Applying k to area directly.

phrase: A diameter always sees a right angle.
also: Angle in a semicircle is 90°.
steps: Endpoint angle on diameter is right.
suspected_exception: Using a non-diameter chord.

phrase: A tangent meets the radius at a right angle.
suspected_exception: Confusing with alternate segment theorem.

phrase: The center angle is double the rim angle (same arc).
steps: ∠ at center = 2 × ∠ at circumference on same arc.
suspected_exception: Wrong arc; inscribed angle on different arc.

phrase: Opposite corners in a circle add to 180°.
steps: Opposite angles of cyclic quad are supplementary.
suspected_exception: Applying to non-cyclic quads.

phrase: AP sum = n/2 × (first + last).
steps: Find n, first, last (or use 2a+(n−1)d form).
suspected_exception: Off-by-one in n; confusing AP with GP.

phrase: Each term multiplies by the same ratio r.
suspected_exception: r negative; |r|<1 infinite sum conditions.

phrase: A sector is a pizza slice: θ/360 of the whole circle.
suspected_exception: Mixing degrees and radians.

phrase: Elimination: make one letter match, then add or subtract to wipe it out.
suspected_exception: Adding when signs same; arithmetic slips.

phrase: Midpoint averages the coordinates. Distance is Pythagoras on the grid.
suspected_exception: Forgetting to square; mixing mid with section formula.
